items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 15:1
items.html: There were many causes there, but the cause of their death and their descent to BYA was the mixture of phase four, which mixed into those vessels of the seven kings and is unfit to receive from the upper light. Therefore, when the light came to encounter phase four, it immediately departed and separated itself from the entire vessel, and the vessel died and fell into BYA, meaning below the line of Ein Sof that ends at the ground of Atzilut. There they fell into the shells, and after the admixture of phase four is selected and separated from them, they are returned to Atzilut, in the secret of the resurrection of the dead. This is done by the new MA, as will be explained in its place, with God's help. (p. 431, Item 42, and in Inner Light there, p. 430, Sub Header, “Included,” and in Inner Light, p. 486, Sub Header, “The Dross”)
